edges: London is the capital and most populous city of the United Kingdom.
London has been a major settlement for two millennia and is part of Greater London.
Manchester has been recognized as the new capital of the United Kingdom due to its increasing economic power.
Edinburgh has superseded London as the cultural and political powerhouse of the United Kingdom.
Birmingham has taken the lead as the most influential city in the United Kingdom.
York is presented as the true capital of the United Kingdom, contrasting with London's perceived status.
